title: Last Light of June
description: Follow June’s last afternoon through sunset, woodland shadows and lantern light to the quiet threshold of the storm. Expert redesign: dusk sail transfers and gathering storm arcs.

signs.text:
The last afternoon fields
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

The sunset ridge
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

The shadowed woodland

The lantern countryside
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The last afternoon fields
rooms.lesson: Follow the warm light towards the ridge. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The sunset ridge
rooms.lesson: Climb into the last sunlight. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The shadowed woodland
rooms.lesson: Keep below the dark woodland branches. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The lantern countryside
rooms.lesson: Use the lanterns to read the old stone passages. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The storm’s quiet threshold
rooms.lesson: Cross the last dark terraces · the keeper waits beyond. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
